topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 67 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 13 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (chainlinkedoraclesimple, oraclesimple, auth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
